app.name: Mahjongyuk
app.tagline: Work out the fan, and who pays who.
variant.title: Which game?
variant.subtitle: Pick the rules your table plays.
variant.singapore.name: Singapore
variant.singapore.blurb: 148 tiles, with the four animals. Fan doubles each step, limit 5.
variant.hongkong.name: Hong Kong Old Style
variant.hongkong.blurb: 144 tiles, no animals. The classic scoring most of the region plays.
tileinfo.title: Check your set
tileinfo.jokers.title: Set came with jokers or spare blanks?
tileinfo.jokers.body: Singapore mahjong does not use them. Set them aside — your count should still come to 148 without them.
hand.bonusHint: Kept aside, never part of the 14.
result.title: Result
result.fanCapped: Capped at the {limit} fan limit — this hand was worth {raw}.
result.instantHint: Paid when you drew them, separately from the hand.
predict.title: What could this become?
predict.comingSoon: Partial hands and tile predictions arrive in a later update.
reject.unknownTile: That is not a tile in this set.
reject.bonusTileInHand: Flowers, seasons and animals are kept aside, not counted in the 14.
reject.duplicateBonusTile: There is only one of each flower, season and animal.
reject.tileCountExceeded: There are only four of each tile.
reject.malformedMeld: That meld is not a valid chow, pong or kong.
reject.wrongTileCount: A winning hand needs 14 tiles, and one more for every kong.
reject.winningTileNotInHand: Pick the winning tile from the tiles in your hand.
reject.noValidDecomposition: These tiles do not make four sets and a pair.
reject.belowMinimum: This hand does not reach the minimum of {min} fan, so it cannot win.
harness.title: Engine harness
harness.note: Developer harness for the scoring engine. The app itself is at mahjongyuk.com.
hand.needWinningTile: Tap the tile that won it
flag.disabled.dealerOnly: Only the dealer can claim this.
flag.disabled.nonDealerOnly: Only a non-dealer can claim this.
hand.full: Hand is full — use Undo to change a tile.
result.paoNote: Pao: {wind} threw the tile that completed it, so they pay the whole settlement and the other two pay nothing.
result.thirteenNote: Thirteen Wonders is paid as a self-draw however it was won, so all three pay the same.
result.nextConfirm: Tap again for the next hand
result.incomplete: This hand is not finished — go back and say how you won.
table.title: Who's playing?
table.subtitle: Set this up once. The app keeps track of the winds and the deal from here.
table.firstDealerHint: The first dealer sits East. Everyone else follows anticlockwise.
table.stakeHint: What each player pays for a one-fan hand. It doubles with every fan.
table.limitHint: The most a hand can score, {min}–{max}. Five is the usual agreement.
menu.title: Table
menu.tilesetSub: Every tile this game needs, so you can count yours.
menu.settingsSub: Change who's playing or what a fan is worth.
menu.notMyHandSub: Move the table on without scoring a hand.
menu.newTableConfirm: Tap again to clear the table
hand.pickChowFirst: Tap the first tile of the run.
hand.pickChowMore: Tap {n} more — only the tiles that can finish this run are live.
hand.concealedKongFound: Four {tile} — counted as a concealed kong, so the hand is one tile longer.
hand.tapWinningTile: Tap the tile that won it.
flag.robbingKong.sub: You took the tile off someone adding it to their pong.
flag.robbingKong.detail: A player already has three of a tile down on the table and draws the fourth, turning their pong into a kong. If that very tile is the one you were waiting on, you take it and win instead. Only a kong made from an existing pong can be robbed.
flag.lastTile.sub: You won on the very last tile that could be drawn.
flag.lastTile.detail: The wall runs out sixteen tiles from the end. Winning on that last drawable tile scores an extra fan. It does not count if the tile came to you as a replacement after a flower or a kong.
flag.kongReplacement.sub: You konged, drew the replacement, and it won.
flag.kongReplacement.detail: After declaring a kong you draw a replacement tile from the back of the wall. If that tile completes your hand, it is worth an extra fan.
flag.flowerReplacement.sub: You drew a flower, and its replacement won.
flag.flowerReplacement.detail: Flowers, seasons and animals are set aside and replaced from the back of the wall. If the replacement completes your hand, it is worth an extra fan.
flag.heavenly.sub: You dealt, and your very first fourteen tiles already won.
flag.heavenly.detail: The dealer looks at the hand they were dealt and it is already complete, before anyone has drawn or discarded. Only the dealer can have this.
flag.earthly.sub: You won on the dealer's very first discard.
flag.earthly.detail: A non-dealer wins on the first tile the dealer throws, or on their own first draw. Only a non-dealer can have this.
flag.humanly.sub: You won in the first go round, before your first draw.
flag.humanly.detail: A non-dealer wins on a discard in the opening circuit, before drawing, with nobody having melded anything except a concealed kong.
flag.kongOnKong.sub: Two kongs in a row, and the second replacement won.
flag.kongOnKong.detail: You kong, draw the replacement, and it lets you kong again. The replacement for that second kong completes your hand. It needs at least two kongs.
flag.pao.sub: One player fed the winning hand and pays for everyone.
flag.pao.detail: Some tables play that a player who visibly hands you the hand — throwing the third dragon into two exposed dragon pongs, say — pays the whole settlement themselves and the other two pay nothing.
